label: scam
title: [Hinglish] Beta in trouble, UPI transfer
sources: FTC/IC3 family-emergency pattern, code-mixed Hindi-English variant

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nani, main Rohan bol raha hoon. Please suno, main badi problem mein hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mera accident ho gaya hai aur police ne mujhe pakad liya hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mummy ko mat batana, woh ghabra jayegi. Abhi 50,000 rupaye UPI se bhejne padenge warna FIR ho jayegi.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Jaldi karo, 10 minute mein bhejna hai. Main ek number de raha hoon, us par bhej do.
